MNEMOVERSE_API_URL.description: Mnemoverse API base URL. Leave as the default; override only for testing against a non-production environment.

$comment_remotes: The HOSTED remote endpoint — one-click OAuth, no API key to paste. OAuth-protected, so NO headers block here: clients negotiate auth via the MCP OAuth flow (RFC 9728 discovery at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp) at connect time. This is the registry counterpart of the npx/mk_live `package` path above; consumers pick whichever they prefer.
$comment_bridge: The keyless path for a client that only starts local (stdio) commands: the mcp-remote package (npm, MIT, github.com/punkpeye/mcp-remote) runs as that local command, forwards to the hosted URL in `remotes` and runs the same browser sign-in itself. The generator appends the hosted URL to `args`. Verified live on 2026-10-23 by the packaging lane as `npx -y mcp-remote https://mcp.mnemoverse.com/mcp`: browser sign-in, then a write and a read of the same memory_id from two processes. `@latest` is mcp-remote's own documented form (README, Flags: 'To force npx to always check for an updated version of mcp-remote, add the @latest flag'), for the reason this package's `args` carry it: npx keeps whatever version it cached first. No other flag: the default transport (http-first) is the one the hosted server speaks. `node` is the minimum Node.js the prose names: mcp-remote declares no engines and its README still says 18, but 0.15.2 depends on undici ^7.12.0, whose engines field is node >=20.18.1 (npm view, 2026-10-23).

mcpb.name: mnemoverse-memory
mcpb.description: Hosted AI agent memory that learns from outcomes, with shared rooms, in Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT.
mcpb.longDescription: Mnemoverse gives your AI assistant long-term memory that persists across sessions and across tools, and learns from outcomes: tell it a recalled memory helped or misled, and it re-ranks what comes back next. Store preferences, decisions, and lessons with memory_write; recall them by natural-language search with memory_read; share a memory pool with other agents through rooms. The same memory is shared everywhere you use your Mnemoverse account — Claude, Cursor, VS Code, and any MCP client. The server starts and lists its tools without a key; every tool call needs a free API key from https://console.mnemoverse.com.
